title: Tushen Figma: fayiloli masu tsabta, shimfidar wurare masu sassauƙa, natsuwa na gani

say: Tushen Figma: fayiloli masu tsabta, shimfidar wurare masu sassauƙa da natsuwa na gani.
Wannan shine bidiyon don ƙirar ɗaya na UI Design tare da Figma.
Gudun UX yana gaya muku abin da dole ne samfur yayi. Firam ɗin waya yana nuna ƙaƙƙarfan shimfidar wuri a cikin akwatunan launin toka.

panel.kicker: Me ya sa wannan ya shafi
panel.heading: Daga kwararar UX zuwa allo mai ginawa
items: Gudun UX yana faɗin abin da samfurin yake yi
Wurin waya yana nuna ƙananan akwatuna masu launin toka
Zane na UI yana ba da madaidaicin dubawa
Launuka, fonts, tazara, kowace jiha

say: Ƙirar UI tana jujjuya wannan zuwa ainihin madaidaicin ƙirar mai haɓakawa zai gina: launuka na gaske, ainihin haruffa, ainihin tazara a cikin pixels, da kowane maɓalli.
Figma yana gudana a cikin burauzar gidan yanar gizo, don haka abokin ciniki, mai haɓakawa kuma kuna iya buɗe fayil iri ɗaya a lokaci guda.

say: Tsarin atomatik, Shift da A, yana juya firam zuwa tari mai sassauƙa. Kuna zabar jagora, tazara tsakanin abubuwa, da manne a ciki. Sabbin abubuwa suna shiga, kuma tazarar ta kasance iri ɗaya a ko'ina.

say: Sunan launuka ta matsayi, kamar firamare, saman da kuskure, don haka sake suna yana canza ƙima, ba ma'ana ba.
Ci gaba da matsawa aƙalla 48 ta 48. Yi amfani da bambanci mai ƙarfi, saboda mutane suna duba umarni a cikin hasken rana mai haske. Ka tuna kowane babban hoto yana kashe bayanai.
Kuma rubuta ainihin kalmomin gida tare da alamun sauti kafin zabar font. Akwatunan da babu komai suna nufin font ɗin baya tallafa musu.
